method_note: ASCEND 2026 (Washington DC, May 2026) online program is offline. Counted technical papers per topic area from the 5 proceedings volumes 'Papers Presented at ASCEND 2026' (proceedings.com IDs 85702-85706): 125 papers, exactly matching the official recap ('125 Paper Presentations', 28 technical sessions). Only the technical-paper program is measured; the >250 panel/collaborative sessions (policy, economy, national security talks) are not counted. Each volume mapped to at most 2 keywords, so broad volumes (Space Programs and Technologies, 53 papers, which also contains ISAM, ISRU, launch, AI-operations papers) are coarsely mapped. deployable-structures added 2026-10-16: paper titles in the 5 ASCEND 2026 TOCs were screened; 1 paper (origami-based polyhedral structures, Space Exploration volume) fits, so weight = 1/125 = 0.008, taken 0.5/0.5 from exploration and human-spaceflight (the two keywords the Space Exploration volume was split across). Not counted: a solar-sail racing competition rationale paper (Space Economy), a DMD-based solar-sail attitude-control method and ISAM latching/assembly papers (Space Programs and Technologies).
